daas-irab:30-31.t: ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: ذا is a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "الأمر ذلك" (the matter is that); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive. ﴿مَنْ﴾: a jussive-governing conditional noun, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يُعَظِّمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿حُرُماتِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ﴾: the fāʾ binds the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); هو is mubtadaʾ and خير is khabar; the two clauses of condition and apodosis are in the position of nominative as the khabar of من. ﴿لَهُ﴾: [preposition and its genitive noun] attached to (mutaʿalliq) خير. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to خير. ﴿رَبِّهِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَ﴾: resumptive. ﴿أُحِلَّتْ﴾: a passive past verb; the tāʾ is the tāʾ of the feminine. ﴿لَكُمُ﴾: attached to أحلت. ﴿الْأَنْعامُ﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿ما﴾: relative, in the position of accusative as the excepted. ﴿يُتْلى﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil is omitted. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: attached to the verb; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿فَاجْتَنِبُوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿الرِّجْسَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ الْأَوْثانِ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَاجْتَنِبُوا قَوْلَ﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الزُّورِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿حُنَفاءَ﴾: an accusative ḥāl. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) by the lām; both attached to حنفاء. ﴿غَيْرَ﴾: an accusative ḥāl. ﴿مُشْرِكِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿بِهِ﴾: attached to مشركين. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and من is conditional, mubtadaʾ. ﴿يُشْرِكْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive, the protasis; the fāʿil is "هو". ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, genitive by the bāʾ; both attached to يشرك. ﴿فَكَأَنَّما﴾: the fāʾ binds the apodosis, and كأنما is "the restraining and the restrained" (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿خَرَّ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the apodosis, and the two clauses of condition and apodosis are the khabar of من. ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾: attached to خر. ﴿فَتَخْطَفُهُ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الطَّيْرُ﴾: a postponed fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿تَهْوِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ because of heaviness. ﴿بِهِ﴾: attached to تهوي. ﴿الرِّيحُ﴾: fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي مَكانٍ﴾: attached to تهوي. ﴿سَحِيقٍ﴾: naʿt (adjective).

daas-irab:32-33.t: ﴿ذا﴾: a demonstrative, khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "الأمر ذلك" (the matter is that); the clause is resumptive; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and من is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ. ﴿يُعَظِّمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿شَعائِرَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَإِنَّها﴾: the fāʾ binds the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); إن and its noun. ﴿مِنْ تَقْوَى﴾: من is a preposition and تقوى is genitive (majrūr) with the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility; both are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar. ﴿الْقُلُوبِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause of the protasis and its apodosis is in the position of nominative as the khabar of من. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: attached to the omitted fronted khabar. ﴿فِيها﴾: attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿مَنافِعُ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿مَحِلُّها﴾: mubtadaʾ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَى الْبَيْتِ﴾: attached to the khabar. ﴿الْعَتِيقِ﴾: naʿt (adjective); the clause is conjoined to the preceding clause. The meaning of عتيق: because it is the first House set up for mankind; and it is said: because no one ever owned it; and العتيق in the language is the choicest of everything.

daas-irab:34-35.t: ﴿وَلِكُلِّ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām is a preposition and كل is a genitive (majrūr) noun; both are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of جعلنا. ﴿أُمَّةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿جَعَلْنا مَنْسَكاً﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its first mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِيَذْكُرُوا﴾: the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl); an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of causation; the wāw is fāʿil; the lām and what follows it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), both attached to جعلنا. ﴿اسْمَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلى ما﴾: attached to يذكروا. ﴿رَزَقَهُمْ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the hāʾ is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi and the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of a relative noun. ﴿مِنْ بَهِيمَةِ﴾: attached to رزقهم. ﴿الْأَنْعامِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. ﴿فَإِلهُكُمْ إِلهٌ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate). ﴿واحِدٌ﴾: a nominative (marfūʿ) naʿt (adjective); the clause has no grammatical position because it is resumptive. ﴿فَلَهُ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أسلموا. ﴿أَسْلِمُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَبَشِّرِ الْمُخْبِتِينَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or resumptive; بشر is an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent, and a mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is conjoined or resumptive. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, badal (substitute) of, or naʿt to, المخبتين. ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb containing the meaning of condition. ﴿ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ﴾: a passive past verb, and the Name of Majesty is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَالصَّابِرِينَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and الصابرين is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الذين; it is accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿عَلى﴾: a preposition. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive by على; both are attached to الصابرين. ﴿أَصابَهُمْ﴾: a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is ṣila. ﴿وَالْمُقِيمِي﴾: maʿṭūf to الذين. ﴿الصَّلاةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive. ﴿وَمِمَّا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, من is a preposition and ما is relative; both are attached to رزقناهم. ﴿رَزَقْناهُمْ﴾: a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is ṣila. [Translator's note: the fāʿil of رزقناهم is in fact the overt attached pronoun "نا"; the source says "latent".] ﴿يُنْفِقُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is likewise ṣila.

daas-irab:36-36.t: ﴿وَالْبُدْنَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and البدن is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "جعلنا"; the clause is resumptive. البدن has also been read in the nominative, as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿جَعَلْناها﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is explicative (mufassira), or khabar (predicate) on the second reading. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) جعلناها. ﴿مِنْ شَعائِرِ اللَّهِ﴾: attached to جعلناها, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿فِيها﴾: attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, revealing an omitted condition; an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلَيْها﴾: attached to اذكروا. ﴿صَوافَّ﴾: i.e. standing close to one another, with one of the legs hobbled; it is a ḥāl (circumstantial), not taking tanwīn (a diptote) because it is on the pattern of the ultimate plural (ṣīghat muntahā al-jumūʿ). It has also been read صوافن, i.e. on one leg, and صواف and صوافي, i.e. purely for Allah the Exalted. ﴿فَإِذا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a conditional adverb. ﴿وَجَبَتْ﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿جُنُوبُها﴾: fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by annexation. ﴿فَكُلُوا﴾: the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis of إذا; an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مِنْها﴾: attached to كلوا; the clause is the apodosis of إذا, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَأَطْعِمُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. [Translator's note: أطعموا here is an imperative verb; the source says "past".] ﴿الْقانِعَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; its meaning is the one who refrains from asking. ﴿وَالْمُعْتَرَّ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to القانع. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾: the kāf is a preposition and ذا is genitive; both are attached to a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun). ﴿سَخَّرْناها﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is ḥāl, i.e. in the state of being made subservient. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: attached to سخرناها. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾: لعل is a particle resembling the verb, the kāf is its noun and the mīm is for the plural. ﴿تَشْكُرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of لعل. The clause لعلكم etc. is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl from لكم, or is causal (taʿlīliyya) with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:37-37.t: ﴿لَنْ﴾: governs the accusative. ﴿يَنالَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by لن. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لُحُومُها﴾: a postponed fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and لا is conjoined. ﴿دِماؤُها﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to لحومها with the ḍamma, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿يَنالُهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿التَّقْوى﴾: a postponed fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from التقوى. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾: the kāf is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), and ذا is a demonstrative in the position of genitive (majrūr); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿سَخَّرَها﴾: a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: attached to the verb; the clause is ḥāl. ﴿لِتُكَبِّرُوا﴾: the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl); an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām of causation; the wāw is fāʿil; the preposition and what follows it are attached to what precedes. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَلى﴾: a preposition. ﴿ما﴾: relative; both are attached to تكبروا. ﴿هَداكُمْ﴾: a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَبَشِّرِ الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; an imperative verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:38-39.t: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: إن is a particle resembling the verb, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿يُدافِعُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); the clause is khabar (predicate). ﴿عَنِ﴾: a preposition. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: relative, in the position of genitive (majrūr); both are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يدافع. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: إن, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿يُحِبُّ كُلَّ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and its accusative mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مختال﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فخور﴾: naʿt (adjective); the clause is the khabar of إن. ﴿أُذِنَ﴾: a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is omitted. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾: the lām is a preposition, and a relative noun in the position of genitive; both are attached to أذن; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يُقاتَلُونَ﴾: a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative. ﴿بِأَنَّهُمْ﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, أن is a particle resembling the verb, the hāʾ is its noun and the mīm is for the plural; the interpreted maṣdar is genitive by the bāʾ, both attached to أذن. ﴿ظُلِمُوا﴾: a passive past verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of أن. ﴿وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, إن is a particle resembling the verb and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿عَلى نَصْرِهِمْ﴾: attached to the postponed khabar. ﴿لَقَدِيرٌ﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) and قدير is khabar; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:40-40.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: badal (substitute) of the preceding الذين. ﴿أُخْرِجُوا﴾: a passive past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma because it is attached to the wāw of the plural; the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ دِيارِهِمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) أخرجوا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw of the plural. ﴿حَقٍّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ﴾: governs the accusative. ﴿يَقُولُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is badal of حق. ﴿رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), and the Name of Majesty is khabar (predicate); نا is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَلَوْلا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and لولا is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿دَفْعُ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; the khabar is obligatorily omitted. ﴿النَّاسَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of دفع, the maṣdar being annexed to its fāʿil. ﴿بَعْضَهُمْ﴾: badal of الناس, accusative, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِبَعْضٍ﴾: attached to دفع; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَهُدِّمَتْ﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); and ﴿لَهُدِّمَتْ صَوامِعُ﴾: a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil, the tāʾ being for the feminine; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَبِيَعٌ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to صوامع. ﴿وَصَلَواتٌ﴾: maʿṭūf to صوامع. ﴿وَمَساجِدُ﴾: also maʿṭūf; it is a diptote because it is on the pattern مفاعل. ﴿يُذْكَرُ﴾: a passive imperfect verb. ﴿فِيهَا﴾: attached to يذكر. ﴿اسْمُ﴾: nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَثِيراً﴾: naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), its implied form being "ذكرا كثيرا" (much remembrance). ﴿وَلَيَنْصُرَنَّ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam), and ينصرن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿مِنْ﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَنْصُرُهُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is ṣila, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَقَوِيٌّ﴾: إن, its noun and its khabar, and the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿عَزِيزٌ﴾: a second khabar, nominative; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:41-44.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), or badal (substitute) of the preceding الذين. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a jussive-governing conditional particle. ﴿مَكَّنَّاهُمْ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is attached to the نا denoting the agents, which is assimilated; نا is fāʿil (agent), the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the mīm is for the plural; the verb is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) مكناهم. ﴿أَقامُوا﴾: a past verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a condition not joined to the fāʾ nor to the إذا of surprise. [Translator's note: the source says "no grammatical position" here, while the common rule is that a past-verb apodosis of a jussive condition is in the position of jussive.] ﴿الصَّلاةَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَآتَوُا الزَّكاةَ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَأَمَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined by the wāw. ﴿بِالْمَعْرُوفِ﴾: attached to أمروا. ﴿وَنَهَوْا﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ﴾: attached to نهوا. ﴿وَلِلَّهِ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, the lām is a preposition and the Name of Majesty is genitive (majrūr) by the preposition; both attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿عاقِبَةُ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْأُمُورِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إن is a jussive-governing conditional. ﴿يُكَذِّبُوكَ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is fāʿil and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; it is the protasis. ﴿فَقَدْ﴾: the fāʾ binds the apodosis, and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿كَذَّبَتْ﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿قَبْلَهُمْ﴾: an adverb of time, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قَوْمُ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿نُوحٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَعادٌ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿وَثَمُودُ﴾: maʿṭūf to نوح; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. [Translator's note: عاد and ثمود are nominative and are conjoined to قوم, not to نوح; the source says "to نوح".] ﴿وَقَوْمُ﴾: maʿṭūf to what precedes it. ﴿إِبْراهِيمَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿وَقَوْمُ﴾: maʿṭūf to what precedes. ﴿لُوطٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَصْحابُ﴾: maʿṭūf to what precedes. ﴿مَدْيَنَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the fatḥa because it is a diptote, owing to being a proper name and foreign. ﴿وَكُذِّبَ مُوسى﴾: a passive past verb, and موسى is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility; the clause is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿فَأَمْلَيْتُ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; a past verb, and the tāʾ is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لِلْكافِرِينَ﴾: the lām is a preposition, and الكافرين is genitive by the lām, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; both attached to أمليت. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction for sequence with delay. ﴿أَخَذْتُهُمْ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the mīm is for the plural; the clause is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿فَكَيْفَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and كيف is an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as the fronted khabar of كان. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿نَكِيرِ﴾: the nominative noun of كان; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:45-46.t: ﴿فَكَأَيِّنْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; كأين is mubtadaʾ (subject) in the position of nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿قَرْيَةٍ﴾: tamyīz (specification) of كأين, genitive (majrūr); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَهْلَكْناها﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَهِيَ ظالِمَةٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَهِيَ خاوِيَةٌ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿عَلى عُرُوشِها﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) خاوية, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَبِئْرٍ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and بئر is conjoined to قرية. ﴿مُعَطَّلَةٍ﴾: a genitive naʿt (adjective). ﴿وَقَصْرٍ مَشِيدٍ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, قصر is a conjoined noun and مشيد is its naʿt. ﴿أَفَلَمْ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, and لم is a particle of negation, jussive and conversion (to the past). ﴿يَسِيرُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: attached to يسيروا. ﴿فَتَكُونَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the fāʾ of causation (al-fāʾ al-sababiyya); the clause is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿قُلُوبٌ﴾: its postponed noun. ﴿يَعْقِلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is a naʿt of قلوب. ﴿بِها﴾: attached to يعقلون. ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿آذانٌ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to قلوب. ﴿يَسْمَعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil. ﴿بِها﴾: attached to the verb; the clause is a naʿt of آذان. ﴿فَإِنَّها﴾: the fāʾ is causal (taʿlīliyya); إن and its noun; the clause is for causation, with no grammatical position. ﴿لا﴾: negative. ﴿تَعْمَى﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility; the clause is khabar. ﴿الْأَبْصارُ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿تَعْمَى﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative. ﴿الْقُلُوبُ﴾: fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿الَّتِي﴾: a relative noun in the position of nominative as a naʿt of القلوب. ﴿فِي الصُّدُورِ﴾: attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.

daas-irab:47-48.t: ﴿وَيَسْتَعْجِلُونَكَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is fāʿil (agent) and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِالْعَذابِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) يستعجلونك. ﴿وَلَنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and لن governs the accusative. ﴿يُخْلِفَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿وَعْدَهُ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَإِنَّ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and إن is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿يَوْماً﴾: its noun. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of يوم. ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿كَأَلْفِ﴾: attached to the khabar (predicate) of إن. ﴿سَنَةٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: من is a preposition and ما is relative, in the position of genitive (majrūr); both attached to an omitted naʿt of سنة. ﴿تَعُدُّونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَكَأَيِّنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and كأين is mubtadaʾ (subject) in the position of nominative. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿قَرْيَةٍ﴾: a genitive noun, tamyīz (specification) of كأين; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَمْلَيْتُ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the tāʾ is fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كأين. ﴿لَها﴾: attached to أمليت. ﴿وَهِيَ ظالِمَةٌ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿أَخَذْتُها﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَإِلَيَّ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, circumstantial or resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿الْمَصِيرُ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined, circumstantial or resumptive.

daas-irab:49-51.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is obligatorily latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾: أي is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of accusative (manṣūb) by the vocative; the hāʾ is for alerting (tanbīh). ﴿النَّاسُ﴾: badal (substitute) of أي. ﴿إِنَّما﴾: kāffa wa-makfūfa (the restraining and the restrained). ﴿أَنَا﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the postponed khabar (predicate). ﴿نَذِيرٌ﴾: khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾: naʿt (adjective); the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَالَّذِينَ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive, and the relative noun is mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined by the wāw. ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿مَغْفِرَةٌ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is the khabar of الذين. ﴿وَرِزْقٌ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to مغفرة. ﴿كَرِيمٌ﴾: naʿt. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the relative noun is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿سَعَوْا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is ṣila. ﴿فِي آياتِنا﴾: attached to سعوا, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مُعاجِزِينَ﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: أولاء is a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَصْحابُ﴾: khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْجَحِيمِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the khabar of الذين.

daas-irab:52-53.t: ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive and ما is negative. ﴿أَرْسَلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a preposition. ﴿قَبْلِكَ﴾: both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb أرسلنا. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿رَسُولٍ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on its end, its appearance prevented by the place being occupied with the vowel of the redundant preposition. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and لا is redundant. ﴿نَبِيٍّ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to رسول according to the wording. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb containing the meaning of condition. ﴿تَمَنَّى﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied on the alif because of impossibility, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) of إذا. ﴿أَلْقَى﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif because of impossibility. ﴿الشَّيْطانُ﴾: fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿فِي أُمْنِيَّتِهِ﴾: attached to ألقى, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَيَنْسَخُ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يُلْقِي الشَّيْطانُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative with the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ because of heaviness, and its fāʿil; the clause is ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿يُحْكِمُ اللَّهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil. ﴿آياتِهِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its two khabars (predicates); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِيَجْعَلَ﴾ [الله]: the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl); an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām of causation, and the Name of Majesty is fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive, and both are attached to يحكم. [Translator's note: the source places "الله" after the bracket here; the Quranic text is ﴿لِيَجْعَلَ﴾ with the fāʿil latent, referring to Allah.] ﴿ما﴾: relative, in the position of accusative as the first mafʿūl bihi of يجعل. ﴿يُلْقِي الشَّيْطانُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative with the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ because of heaviness, and its fāʿil; the clause is ṣila, with no grammatical position. ﴿فِتْنَةً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾: the lām is a preposition and the relative noun is in the position of genitive; both attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of فتنة. ﴿فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾: attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿مَرَضٌ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is ṣila. ﴿وَالْقاسِيَةِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and القاسية is conjoined to الذين. ﴿قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾: fāʿil of the active participle قاسية. ﴿وَإِنَّ﴾: the wāw is resumptive and إن is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾: its noun. ﴿لَفِي شِقاقٍ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and both [preposition and noun] are attached to the khabar of إن. ﴿بَعِيدٍ﴾: naʿt of شقاق; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:54-55.t: ﴿وَلِيَعْلَمَ﴾: the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and the imperfect verb is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of causation; it is conjoined to ليجعل. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: fāʿil (agent). ﴿أُوتُوا﴾: a passive past verb, and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative. ﴿الْعِلْمَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ﴾: أن, its noun and its khabar (predicate), standing in place of the two objects of يعلم. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَيُؤْمِنُوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; an imperfect verb conjoined to يعلم and accusative like it, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿بِهِ﴾: attached to يؤمنوا. ﴿فَتُخْبِتَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the imperfect verb is conjoined to what precedes it and accusative like it; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَهُ﴾: attached to تخبت. ﴿قُلُوبُهُمْ﴾: fāʿil; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi and the mīm is for the plural. ﴿وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إن, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَهادِ﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and هاد is the khabar of إن, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the omitted yāʾ; it has also been read with the yāʾ retained. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of the active participle هاد. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is ṣila, with no grammatical position. ﴿إِلى صِراطٍ﴾: attached to هاد. ﴿مُسْتَقِيمٍ﴾: naʿt (adjective). ﴿وَلا يَزالُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and لا يزال is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: the noun of لا يزال, in the position of nominative. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is ṣila. ﴿فِي مِرْيَةٍ﴾: attached to the khabar of لا يزال. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: attached to a naʿt of مرية. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit (ghāya) and a preposition. ﴿تَأْتِيَهُمُ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after حتى, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿السَّاعَةُ﴾: fāʿil, nominative; أن and what follows it are in the position of genitive (majrūr) by حتى, both attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿بَغْتَةً﴾: ḥāl. ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿يَأْتِيَهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb conjoined to the preceding تأتيهم and accusative like it, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَذابُ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿يَوْمٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَقِيمٍ﴾: naʿt of يوم.

daas-irab:56-58.t: ﴿الْمُلْكُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾: an adverb annexed to one like it. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: the lām is a preposition and the Name of Majesty is genitive (majrūr); both are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿يَحْكُمُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾: an adverb of place attached to يحكم. ﴿فَالَّذِينَ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive and the relative noun is mubtadaʾ. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَعَمِلُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿الصَّالِحاتِ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra. ﴿فِي جَنَّاتِ﴾: attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿النَّعِيمِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and الذين is mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is ṣila. ﴿وَكَذَّبُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِآياتِنا﴾: attached to كذبوا, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾: the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida). ﴿أولئك﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is for address. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿مُهِينٌ﴾: naʿt (adjective). The clause أولئك لهم عذاب مهين is the khabar of الذين, and the clause لهم عذاب is the khabar of أولئك. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and الذين is mubtadaʾ. ﴿هاجَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is ṣila. ﴿وجاهدوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. [Translator's note: the Quranic text of this verse has no وجاهدوا; it reads ﴿هاجَرُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ قُتِلُوا﴾.] ﴿فِي سَبِيلِ﴾: attached to هاجروا. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿قُتِلُوا﴾: a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) [the source reads "ونائب وفاعله"]; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿ماتُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَيَرْزُقَنَّهُمُ﴾: the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam); an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿رِزْقاً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿حَسَناً﴾: naʿt. The clause of the oath has no grammatical position, and the oath with its complement is in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar of الذين. ﴿وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَهُوَ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and هو is mubtadaʾ. ﴿خَيْرُ﴾: khabar; the clause is the khabar of إن. ﴿الرَّازِقِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:59-61.t: ﴿لَيُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ﴾: the lām prepares for the oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam); an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the mīm is for the plural; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مُدْخَلًا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿يَرْضَوْنَهُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, its fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of مدخلا. ﴿وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَلِيمٌ حَلِيمٌ﴾: إن, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; عليم and حكيم are its two khabars (predicates); and the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause is resumptive. [Translator's note: the Quranic word is حليم; the source writes "حكيم".] ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: ذا is a demonstrative, khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and من is a jussive-governing conditional noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿عاقَبَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); it is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿بِمِثْلِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) عاقب. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عُوقِبَ﴾: a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent pronoun; the clause is ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِهِ﴾: attached to عوقب. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿بُغِيَ﴾: a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil is a latent pronoun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾: attached to بغي. ﴿لَيَنْصُرَنَّهُ اللَّهُ﴾: the lām prepares for the oath; an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi and the Name of Majesty is fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of من. ﴿إن الله لغفور رحيم﴾: إن, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; غفور and رحيم are its two khabars; and the shifted lām; the clause is resumptive. [Translator's note: the Quranic text of verse 60 ends ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌ﴾; the source writes "لغفور رحيم".] ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: أن and what follows it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿يُولِجُ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun. ﴿اللَّيْلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فِي النَّهارِ﴾: attached to يولج. ﴿وَيُولِجُ النَّهارَ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent, and النهار is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي اللَّيْلِ﴾: attached to يولج. ﴿وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ﴾: أن, its noun and its two khabars; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:62-64.t: ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: ذا is a demonstrative in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address; the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, and أن and what follows it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive (majrūr); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿هُوَ الْحَقُّ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is the khabar of أن. ﴿وَأَنَّ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and أن is a particle resembling the verb; and ﴿ما﴾: relative, in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the noun of أن. ﴿يَدْعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil (agent); the clause is ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿هُوَ الْباطِلُ﴾: mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is the khabar of أن. ﴿وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْكَبِيرُ﴾: أن and its noun; the clause هو العلي is the khabar of أن, and الكبير is a second khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَلَمْ﴾: the hamza is for interrogation and affirmation (taqrīr), and لم is a particle of negation, jussive and conversion (to the past). ﴿تَرَ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: أن, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿أَنْزَلَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is khabar. ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾: attached to أنزل; and أن, its noun and its khabar stand in place of the two objects of تر. ﴿ماءً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَتُصْبِحُ الْأَرْضُ مُخْضَرَّةً﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, its noun and its khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌ﴾: إن, its noun and its two khabars; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَهُ﴾: attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿ما﴾: relative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾: attached to an omitted ṣila of ما. ﴿وَما فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: ما is relative, mubtadaʾ [Translator's note: i.e. conjoined to the preceding ما], and في الأرض is attached to the khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: إن and its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَهُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and a mubtadaʾ and its two khabars; the clause is the khabar of إن.

daas-irab:65-66.t: ﴿أَلَمْ﴾: the hamza is for the interrogation of affirmation (al-istifhām al-taqrīrī), and لم is a particle of negation, jussive and conversion (to the past). ﴿تَرَ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter, its fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: أن, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; it stands in place of the two objects of تر. ﴿سَخَّرَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of أن. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) سخر. ﴿ما﴾: relative, in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ما. ﴿وَالْفُلْكَ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ما. ﴿تَجْرِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma, nominative with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ because of heaviness [Translator's note: the phrase is repeated in the source]; the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فِي الْبَحْرِ﴾: attached to تجري. ﴿بِأَمْرِهِ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَيُمْسِكُ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; an imperfect verb, nominative, whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿السَّماءَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ تَقَعَ﴾: أن governs the accusative, and an imperfect verb, accusative, whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَى الْأَرْضِ﴾: attached to تقع; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بِإِذْنِهِ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: إن and its noun. [Translator's note: the Quranic text is ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾; the source's heading has أنّ while its analysis says إن.] ﴿بِالنَّاسِ﴾: attached to the khabar. ﴿لَرَؤُفٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and two khabars of إن; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive and هو is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِي﴾: a relative noun, khabar. ﴿أَحْياكُمْ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied on the alif because of impossibility; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi, the mīm is for the plural, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is ṣila (relative clause). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿يُمِيتُكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿يُحْيِيكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative with the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ because of heaviness; the fāʿil is latent, the kāf is mafʿūl bihi and the mīm is for the plural; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّ الْإِنْسانَ لَكَفُورٌ﴾: إن, its noun and its khabar, and the shifted lām; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:67-69.t: ﴿لِكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) جعلنا, and the two of them stand in place of its second object. ﴿جَعَلْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَنْسَكاً﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿هُمْ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿ناسِكُوهُ﴾: khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the nūn was dropped for the annexation; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of منسكا. ﴿فَلا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa and لا is prohibitive. ﴿يُنازِعُنَّكَ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is fāʿil and was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the nūn is the heavy nūn of emphasis, and it did not take effect here because it is not directly attached to the imperfect verb; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the implied condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿فِي الْأَمْرِ﴾: attached to ينازعنك. ﴿وَادْعُ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿إِلى رَبِّكَ﴾: attached to ادع, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾: إن and its noun. ﴿لَعَلى هُدىً﴾: attached to the omitted khabar, and the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿مُسْتَقِيمٍ﴾: naʿt of هدى; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive and إن is a jussive-governing conditional. ﴿جادَلُوكَ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma because it is attached to the wāw of the plural; the wāw is the fāʿil; it is in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَقُلِ﴾: the fāʾ binds the apodosis; an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ﴾: the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ and أعلم is its khabar; the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بِما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition and ما is relative; both attached to أعلم. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is ṣila (relative clause). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَحْكُمُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is khabar, and the clause الله يحكم is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿بَيْنَكُمْ﴾: an adverb of place attached to يحكم, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾: an adverb of time. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِيما﴾: في is a preposition and ما is relative; both attached to يحكم. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: كان and its noun; the clause is ṣila. ﴿فِيهِ﴾: attached to تختلفون. ﴿تَخْتَلِفُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كنتم.

daas-irab:70-71.t: ﴿أَلَمْ﴾: the hamza is for the interrogation of affirmation (al-istifhām al-taqrīrī), and لم is a particle of negation, jussive and conversion (to the past). ﴿تَعْلَمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: أن, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; [this is] to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) standing in place of the two objects of تعلم. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of أن. ﴿ما﴾: relative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِي السَّماءِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) the ṣila (relative clause) of ما. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to السماء. ﴿أَنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: ذا is a demonstrative in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the noun of إن; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. [Translator's note: the Quranic text is ﴿إِنَّ ذلِكَ فِي كِتابٍ﴾; the source's heading has أنّ while its analysis says إن.] ﴿فِي كِتابٍ﴾: attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿إِنَّ ذلِكَ﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾: attached to يسير. ﴿يَسِيرٌ﴾: the khabar of إن; the two clauses are causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَيَعْبُدُونَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾: attached to يعبدون. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ما﴾: relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَمْ﴾: a particle of negation, conversion and jussive. ﴿يُنَزِّلْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive; the clause is ṣila. ﴿بِهِ﴾: attached to ينزل. ﴿سُلْطاناً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿ما﴾: relative, conjoined to the preceding ما. ﴿لَيْسَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: the lām is a preposition and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive (majrūr); both attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿بِهِ﴾: attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿عِلْمٌ﴾: the postponed noun of ليس; the clause of ليس is the ṣila of ما. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a particle of resumption and ما is negative. ﴿لِلظَّالِمِينَ﴾: attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿نَصِيرٍ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma, whose appearance is prevented by the place being occupied with the vowel of the redundant preposition. The clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:72-72.t: ﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and إذا is an adverb containing the meaning of condition. ﴿تُتْلى﴾: a passive imperfect verb; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) تتلى. ﴿آياتُنا﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بَيِّناتٍ﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial) from آياتنا, accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿تَعْرِفُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿فِي وُجُوهِ﴾: attached to تعرف. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is ṣila (relative clause). ﴿الْمُنْكَرَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يَكادُونَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, and the wāw is its noun; the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿يَسْطُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of يكادون. ﴿بِالَّذِينَ﴾: الذين is a relative noun; both attached to يسطون. ﴿يَتْلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is ṣila. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: attached to يتلون. ﴿آياتُنا﴾: mafʿūl bihi, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قُلْ﴾: an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَفَأُنَبِّئُكُمْ﴾: the hamza is an interrogative particle; an imperfect verb and a mafʿūl bihi, the mīm for the plural, and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بِشَرٍّ﴾: attached to أنبئكم. ﴿مِنْ ذلِكُمُ﴾: attached to شر; ذا is a demonstrative, the lām is for distance, the kāf for address and the mīm for the plural. ﴿النَّارُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿وَعَدَهَا﴾: a past verb and its first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, a postponed fāʿil; the clause is khabar. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative as second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is ṣila. ﴿وَبِئْسَ﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and بئس is a past verb for expressing blame. ﴿الْمَصِيرُ﴾: fāʿil; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:73-74.t: ﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾: the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied أدعو (I call); the hāʾ is a particle of alerting (tanbīh) with no grammatical position. ﴿النَّاسُ﴾: badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); the clause is resumptive. ﴿ضُرِبَ مَثَلٌ﴾: a passive past verb and nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿فَاسْتَمِعُوا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿لَهُ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) استمعوا; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: relative, in the position of accusative as the noun of إن; the clause إن الذين is explicative (tafsīriyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿تَدْعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾: attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لَنْ يَخْلُقُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative by لن, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn. ﴿ذُباباً﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إن. ﴿وَلَوِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and لو is a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿اجْتَمَعُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿لَهُ﴾: attached to اجتمعوا; the clause is conjoined; the clause اجتمعوا is the clause of the condition, initial, with no grammatical position; and the apodosis of لو is omitted, its implied form being "لا يقدرون" (they would not be able). ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive and إن is conditional. ﴿يَسْلُبْهُمُ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الذُّبابُ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is initial, with no grammatical position. ﴿لا يَسْتَنْقِذُوهُ﴾: لا is negative; an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is fāʿil and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: attached to the verb before it; the clause has no grammatical position because it is not joined to the binding fāʾ. ﴿ضَعُفَ الطَّالِبُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿وَالْمَطْلُوبُ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الطالب; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾: negative. ﴿قَدَرُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿حَقَّ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿قَدْرِهِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَقَوِيٌّ عَزِيزٌ﴾: إن, its noun and its two khabars, and the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:75-77.t: ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَصْطَفِي﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) because of heaviness; the clause is khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنَ الْمَلائِكَةِ﴾: attached to (mutaʿalliq) يصطفي or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause الله يصطفي is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿رُسُلًا﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَمِنَ النَّاسِ﴾: maʿṭūf (conjoined) to من الملائكة. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ بَصِيرٌ﴾: إن, its noun and its two khabars; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative, whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾: relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَيْدِيهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَما﴾: relative, conjoined to the preceding ما. ﴿خَلْفَهُمْ﴾: an adverb of place attached to an omitted ṣila, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَإِلَى اللَّهِ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to ترجع. ﴿تُرْجَعُ﴾: a passive imperfect verb. ﴿الْأُمُورُ﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾: the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), in the position of accusative (manṣūb) by the vocative; the hāʾ is for alerting (tanbīh). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is ṣila. ﴿ارْكَعُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿وَاسْجُدُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَاعْبُدُوا رَبَّكُمْ﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَافْعَلُوا الْخَيْرَ﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾: لعل and its noun, and the mīm is for the plural. ﴿تُفْلِحُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of لعل.

daas-irab:78-78.t: ﴿وَجاهِدُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined. [Translator's note: جاهدوا here is an imperative verb; the source says "past".] ﴿فِي اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive (majrūr) by في; both attached to (mutaʿalliq) جاهدوا. ﴿حَقَّ﴾: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (nāʾib mafʿūl muṭlaq, standing in for the absolute object). ﴿جِهادِهِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هُوَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اجْتَباكُمْ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility; the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the mīm is for the plural, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is khabar (predicate). ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negative. ﴿جَعَلَ﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: attached to جعل; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فِي الدِّينِ﴾: attached to جعل. ﴿مِنْ﴾: a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿حَرَجٍ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) in position and genitive in wording by the vowel of the redundant preposition. ﴿مِلَّةَ﴾: accusative by specialisation (ikhtiṣāṣ), i.e. "أخص ملة" (I mean specifically the creed). ﴿أَبِيكُمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the yāʾ because it is one of the five nouns, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِبْراهِيمَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive with the fatḥa because it is a diptote, owing to being a proper name and foreign. [Translator's note: إبراهيم is more commonly parsed as badal (substitute) of أبيكم; the source says muḍāf ilayhi.] ﴿هُوَ﴾: mubtadaʾ; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿سَمَّاكُمُ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif because of impossibility; the kāf is first mafʿūl bihi and the mīm is for the plural; the clause is khabar. ﴿الْمُسْلِمِينَ﴾: second mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾: attached to سماكم; قبل is indeclinable on the ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation in wording but not in meaning. ﴿وَفِي هذا﴾: ذا is a demonstrative in the position of genitive by the preposition; both attached to an omitted verb indicated by what precedes, and it is conjoined to من قبل. ﴿لِيَكُونَ﴾: the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and يكون is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb. ﴿الرَّسُولُ﴾: the noun of كان. ﴿شَهِيداً﴾: khabar. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: attached to شهيدا; [the implied] أن, the lām and what follows them are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), both attached to سماكم. ﴿وَتَكُونُوا﴾: an incomplete imperfect verb conjoined to what precedes it, accusative by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿شُهَداءَ﴾: khabar. ﴿عَلَى النَّاسِ﴾: attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective). ﴿فَأَقِيمُوا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿الصَّلاةَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَآتُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and آتوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿الزَّكاةَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَاعْتَصِمُوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾: attached to اعتصموا. ﴿هُوَ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿مَوْلاكُمْ﴾: khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied on the alif because of impossibility; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi and the mīm is for the plural; the clause is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَنِعْمَ الْمَوْلى﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; نعم is a past verb for expressing praise, and المولى is its fāʿil, nominative with the ḍamma implied on the alif because of impossibility; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَنِعْمَ النَّصِيرُ﴾: a past verb that comes for expressing praise, and النصير is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes, and like it has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:1-2.t: ﴿يا﴾ for the vocative. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite noun (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied (muqaddar) أدعو; and ها is for calling attention (tanbīh). ﴿النَّاسُ﴾ badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); the vocative clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿اتَّقُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿رَبَّكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause has no grammatical position because it is initial. ﴿إِنَّ زَلْزَلَةَ السَّاعَةِ شَيْءٌ﴾ إن, its noun and its khabar (predicate), and الساعة is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَظِيمٌ﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of شيء; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya) with no grammatical position. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) تذهل. ﴿تَرَوْنَها﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and ها is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تَذْهَلُ كُلُّ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿مُرْضِعَةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَمَّا﴾ عن is a preposition and ما is relative; the two are attached to تذهل. ﴿أَرْضَعَتْ﴾ a past verb and fāʿil; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). [Translator's note: so in the source; the clause is ordinarily the ṣila (relative clause) of ما.] ﴿وَتَضَعُ كُلُّ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to تذهل. ﴿ذاتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿حَمْلٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿حَمْلَها﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and ها is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَتَرَى﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur), its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿النَّاسَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿سُكارى﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb); the clause is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and ما is negating, operating like ليس. ﴿هُمْ﴾ the noun of ما, in the position of the nominative. ﴿بِسُكارى﴾ the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and سكارى is the khabar, genitive in form, accusative in position; the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿وَلكِنَّ عَذابَ اللَّهِ شَدِيدٌ﴾ لكن, its noun and its khabar, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined to the ḥāl clause and, like it, is in the position of the accusative.

daas-irab:3-7.t: ﴿وَمِنَ النَّاسِ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the nominative as postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive. [Translator's note: the parsed word is the relative noun ﴿مَنْ﴾ of the verse; the source vocalises it مِنَ, here and below.] ﴿يُجادِلُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿فِي اللَّهِ﴾ the two are attached to يجادل. ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), its implied form being جاهلا. ﴿عِلْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَيَتَّبِعُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿كُلَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿شَيْطانٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مَرِيدٍ﴾ a naʿt (adjective). ﴿كُتِبَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached to كتب. ﴿أَنَّهُ﴾ أن and its noun, [forming] an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of كتب. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, or a relative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿تَوَلَّاهُ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur), its fāʿil latent, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَأَنَّهُ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis, and أن and its noun; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿يُضِلُّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the khabar of أن. ﴿وَيَهْدِيهِ﴾ the clause is conjoined to يضله. ﴿إِلى عَذابِ﴾ the two are attached to يهديه. ﴿السَّعِيرِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause of the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) and its apodosis is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ من. ﴿يا﴾ for the vocative. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite noun (nakira maqṣūda), in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of an implied أدعو; and ها is for calling attention (tanbīh). ﴿النَّاسُ﴾ badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition). ﴿إِنْ﴾ a jussive-governing conditional particle. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ كان and its noun. ﴿فِي رَيْبٍ﴾ the two are attached to the khabar of كان. ﴿مِنَ الْبَعْثِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted naʿt of ريب. ﴿فَإِنَّا﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis; إن, and نا is its noun. ﴿خَلَقْناكُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the khabar of إن, and the [whole] clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿مِنْ تُرابٍ﴾ the two are attached to خلقناكم. ﴿ثُمَّ مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ مُضْغَةٍ﴾ conjoined to what precedes. ﴿مُخَلَّقَةٍ﴾ a naʿt of مضغة. ﴿وَغَيْرِ﴾ conjoined to مخلقة. ﴿مُخَلَّقَةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِنُبَيِّنَ لَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) أن after the lām of causation (taʿlīl), its fāʿil latent; أن and what follows it are an interpreted maṣdar, [and with the lām] the two are attached to خلقناكم. ﴿وَنُقِرُّ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿فِي الْأَرْحامِ﴾ the two are attached to نقر; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿نَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِلى أَجَلٍ﴾ the two are attached to نقر. ﴿مُسَمًّى﴾ a naʿt of أجل. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿نُخْرِجُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, its fāʿil latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿طِفْلًا﴾ a ḥāl or a tamyīz (specification). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لِتَبْلُغُوا﴾ the lām is for causation, and the imperfect verb is accusative by the implied أن after it, [its accusative marked] by deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the lām and what follows it, as an interpreted maṣdar, are attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being نعمركم. ﴿أَشُدَّكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَمِنْكُمْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and the two are attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿مِنَ﴾ relative, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يُتَوَفَّى﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَمِنْكُمْ مَنْ يُرَدُّ﴾ see the parsing of what precedes it. ﴿إِلى أَرْذَلِ﴾ the two are attached to يرد. ﴿الْعُمُرِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِكَيْلا﴾ the lām is a preposition, كي is an accusative-governing particle, and لا is negating. ﴿يَعْلَمَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by كي, and its fāʿil is latent; the imperfect verb, as an interpreted maṣdar, is in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the two are attached to يرد. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ the two are attached to يعلم. ﴿عِلْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَتَرَى الْأَرْضَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied ḍamma, its fāʿil latent, and الأرض is its object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿هامِدَةً﴾ ḥāl, accusative. ﴿فَإِذا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and إذا is an adverb for future time. ﴿أَنْزَلْنا عَلَيْهَا الْماءَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object, and عليها: the two are attached to أنزلنا; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿اهْتَزَّتْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَرَبَتْ﴾ conjoined to اهتزت, like it. ﴿وَأَنْبَتَتْ﴾ the clause is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿مِنْ كُلِّ﴾ the two are attached to أنبتت. ﴿زَوْجٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بَهِيجٍ﴾ a naʿt, genitive (majrūr). ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ أن, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; its clause, interpreted as a maṣdar, is in the position of the genitive, [and with the bāʾ] the two are attached to an omitted [khabar], its implied form being شاهد. ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْحَقُّ﴾ khabar; the nominal clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of أن. ﴿وَأَنَّهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and أن and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يُحْيِ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿الْمَوْتى﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with an implied fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility; the clause is the khabar of أن. ﴿وَأَنَّهُ﴾ its parsing is like the preceding one, and the clause is likewise conjoined to what precedes. ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾ the two are attached to قدير. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قَدِيرٌ﴾ the khabar of أن, nominative. ﴿وَأَنَّ السَّاعَةَ آتِيَةٌ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; أن, its noun and its khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لا رَيْبَ﴾ لا is the lā of generic negation, and ريب is its noun. ﴿فِيها﴾ the two are attached to the khabar; the clause is a ḥāl from the latent pronoun in آتية. ﴿وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; أن, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَبْعَثُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil latent; the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of أن. ﴿مَنْ﴾ relative, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فِي الْقُبُورِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ṣila.

daas-irab:8-10.t: ﴿وَمِنَ النَّاسِ﴾ the wāw is a particle of resumption, and the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the nominative as postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive. [Translator's note: the parsed word is the relative noun ﴿مَنْ﴾ of the verse; the source vocalises it مِنَ.] ﴿يُجادِلُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿فِي اللَّهِ﴾ the two are attached to يجادل. ﴿بِغَيْرِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عِلْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَلا هُدىً وَلا كِتابٍ﴾ conjoined by the conjunctions. ﴿مُنِيرٍ﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of كتاب, genitive (majrūr) like it. ﴿ثانِيَ﴾ ḥāl, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿عِطْفِهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِيُضِلَّ﴾ the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and يضل is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) أن after the lām of causation; its fāʿil is هو; the clause, as an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), is in the position of the genitive, and the two are attached to يجادل. ﴿عَنْ سَبِيلِ﴾ the two are attached to يضل. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to a fronted khabar. ﴿فِي الدُّنْيا﴾ الدنيا is a genitive noun, genitive with an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur); the two are attached to the fronted khabar. ﴿خِزْيٌ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَنُذِيقُهُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its first object. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to نذيقه. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَذابَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْحَرِيقِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿بِما﴾ ما is relative, and the two are attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿قَدَّمَتْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿يَداكَ﴾ fāʿil, nominative with the alif because it is a dual, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ذلك is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech) of an omitted verb. ﴿وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ أن, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَيْسَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, its noun omitted. ﴿بِظَلَّامٍ﴾ the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and ظلام is the khabar of ليس, genitive in form, accusative in position; the clause of ليس with its noun and khabar is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of أن. ﴿لِلْعَبِيدِ﴾ the two are attached to ظلام.

daas-irab:11-13.t: ﴿وَمِنَ النَّاسِ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and the two (preposition and its genitive noun) are attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنَ﴾ relative, in the position of the nominative as postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is resumptive. [Translator's note: the parsed word is the relative noun ﴿مَنْ﴾ of the verse; the source vocalises it مِنَ.] ﴿يَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and its object is the Name of Majesty, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is a ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position. ﴿عَلى حَرْفٍ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of يعبد. ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive and إن is conditional. ﴿أَصابَهُ خَيْرٌ﴾ a past verb, its fronted object and its postponed fāʿil. ﴿اطْمَأَنَّ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a condition not joined to the fāʾ or to the إذا of surprise. به: the two are attached to the verb. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and إن is conditional. ﴿أَصابَتْهُ فِتْنَةٌ﴾ a past verb, its object and its postponed fāʿil, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the first إن etc. ﴿انْقَلَبَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿عَلى وَجْهِهِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a condition not joined to the fāʾ or to the إذا of surprise. ﴿خَسِرَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿وَالْآخِرَةَ﴾ conjoined to الدنيا, like it; the clause is resumptive or a ḥāl from the fāʿil of انقلب. ﴿وذلك﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), or a second mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْخُسْرانُ﴾ khabar of the second mubtadaʾ, and the clause هو الخسران is the khabar of the first mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْمُبِينُ﴾ a naʿt (adjective) of الخسران, nominative (marfūʿ) like it. ﴿يَدْعُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the wāw owing to heaviness, its fāʿil latent. ﴿مِنْ دُونِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl; the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾ relative, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لا يَضُرُّهُ﴾ لا is negating; an imperfect verb and its object, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَما لا يَنْفَعُهُ﴾ its parsing is like the preceding one, and it is conjoined. ﴿ذلِكَ هُوَ الضَّلالُ الْبَعِيدُ﴾ its parsing is like ذلك هو الخسران المبين. ﴿يَدْعُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the wāw owing to heaviness, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿لَمَنْ﴾ the lām is for commencement (ibtidāʾ) or paves the way for an oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam). ﴿مِنْ﴾ a relative noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿ضَرُّهُ﴾ a second mubtadaʾ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَقْرَبُ﴾ khabar of ضره; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْ نَفْعِهِ﴾ the two are attached to أقرب. ﴿لَبِئْسَ﴾ the lām is the lām of commencement or occurs in the response to an omitted oath, and بئس is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame. ﴿الْمَوْلى﴾ fāʿil of بئس, nominative with an implied ḍamma on the alif owing to impossibility; the clause is the khabar of من. ﴿وَلَبِئْسَ الْعَشِيرُ﴾ its parsing is like the preceding one.

daas-irab:14-15.t: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ إن, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يُدْخِلُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma because it is joined to the wāw of the group, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحاتِ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿جَنَّاتٍ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the kasra. ﴿تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهارُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness; الأنهار is its fāʿil, and من تحتها: the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تجري; the clause is a naʿt (adjective) of جنات, in the position of the accusative. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ إن, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَفْعَلُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the khabar of إن. ﴿ما﴾ relative, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يُرِيدُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is a ṣila with no grammatical position. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a jussive-governing conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كانَ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, its noun omitted, its implied form being هو. ﴿يَظُنُّ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the khabar of كان. ﴿أَنْ﴾ lightened from the heavy أنّ, its noun being the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn). ﴿لَنْ﴾ an accusative-governing particle. ﴿يَنْصُرَهُ اللَّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative, and its fronted object, and the Name of Majesty is its postponed fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of أن, and أن and what follows it, as an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), fill the place of the two objects of يظن. ﴿فِي الدُّنْيا﴾ the two are attached to ينصره. ﴿وَالْآخِرَةِ﴾ conjoined to الدنيا, genitive (majrūr) like it. ﴿فَلْيَمْدُدْ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis, the lām is the lām of command, and the imperfect verb is jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command; the fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the clause of condition and apodosis is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of من. ﴿بِسَبَبٍ﴾ that is, the rope; and السماء here is the ceiling — i.e. whoever despairs of the mercy of Allah, let him hang himself and see whether that brings him any benefit; the two are attached to يمدد. ﴿إِلَى السَّماءِ﴾ the two are attached to يمدد. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿لْيَقْطَعْ﴾ its parsing is like ليمدد, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿فَلْيَنْظُرْ﴾ its parsing is like the preceding one. ﴿هَلْ﴾ an interrogative particle. ﴿يُذْهِبَنَّ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis. ﴿كَيْدُهُ﴾ fāʿil, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ما﴾ relative, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the mafʿūl bihi of ينظر. ﴿يَغِيظُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is a ṣila with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:16-17.t: ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, the kāf is for comparison and ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive by the kāf; the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun). ﴿أَنْزَلْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; the clause is resumptive. ﴿آياتٍ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿بَيِّناتٍ﴾ a naʿt, genitive (majrūr) like the noun it qualifies. [Translator's note: so in the source; as a naʿt of the accusative آيات it is accusative, with the kasra.] ﴿وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ أن, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; its clause is conjoined to the hāʾ in أنزلناه. ﴿يَهْدِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of أن. ﴿يُرِيدُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir); the clause is a ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, the noun of إن. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ conjoined to the الذين before it. ﴿هادُوا﴾ conjoined to what precedes, and its parsing is like it. ﴿وَالصَّابِئِينَ﴾ they are the worshippers of the stars; conjoined to the noun of إن, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿وَالنَّصارى﴾ conjoined to الذين; it is accusative like it, with an implied fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur). ﴿وَالْمَجُوسَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun whose position is the accusative, like what it is conjoined to. ﴿أَشْرَكُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ إن, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿يَفْصِلُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar. ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place attached to يفصل, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to يفصل. ﴿الْقِيامَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi;
